name: code-review-tools
description: Claude Code tooling: portable code review, and a task flow from tracker link to pushed commit.

plugins.name: code-reviewer
plugins.description: Project-agnostic code review: universal correctness, security and performance lenses plus whatever conventions the repo declares in .claude/review/rules.md.

plugins.name: task-flow
plugins.description: Analyse a task into a plan the developer approves, implement it file by file, test the whole module with Playwright, review, then push and comment only after the developer says yes. Project rules come from .claude/task-flow/rules.md in each repo.
